create_word_shuffle_mutator: create a WordShuffleMutator instance with an Opt config to shuffle words in messages
shuffle_message_text: shuffle all words in a message text while preserving newline boundaries between utterances
register_word_shuffle_mutator: register the word_shuffle mutator with Parlai using the register_mutator decorator
mutate_message_words: mutate a message by shuffling its words using a seeded random number generator
combine_with_flatten_mutator: combine the word_shuffle mutator with the flatten mutator to shuffle labels and texts
